title: Two-day workshop path
subtitle: A guided path for complete beginners: install, connect, build, and ship with an AI assistant.
progressHint: Progress stays on this device only.

install.title: Install VibeHub
install.body: Download the official installer and pick "Full VibeHub". The installer bundles its own runtime and changes nothing on your system.

detect.title: Detect a coding app
detect.body: Install one coding app from its official source, then scan again. Free-tier apps with daily credit are enough to start.

connect.title: Connect a free model
connect.body: Save one free-tier connection in the notebook and run its connection test. Selections are manual references; VibeHub never rewrites another tool's settings.

firstProject.title: First project with an assistant
firstProject.body: Create a practice folder, describe what you want, and see your first real page in a browser.

git.title: Record your first change with Git
git.body: Inspect changes and make your first commit in the practice folder. Git keeps history locally; nothing uploads.

debug.title: Debug with the assistant
debug.body: Hand over the full error text, test the guesses one at a time, and verify the fix yourself in the browser.

review.title: Review the assistant's code
review.body: Read the diff, run the checks, and accept only what you understand. You are the reviewer.

final.title: Final project and next steps
final.body: Ship a small project of your own with at least three commits, then pick practice resources to keep going.

facilitator.title: Teaching a class?
facilitator.body: The facilitator plan holds the two-day schedule, checkpoints, failure scenarios, and machine-reset checklist. Lessons refresh from the content feed and also open offline.
